map.name: Durgal
map.trouble: The Ogre chief Bargul has seized the Smelting Pits north of Durgal, the ore no longer comes down and the forges are going cold.

guard_bark.specifics: Brannock keeps the north gate, shut by Guildmaster Krell since Bargul's Ogres took the Smelting Pits.

first.speaker: Brannock
first.text: Whoa! Nobody's going out that gate!

later.speaker: Brannock
later.text: The north gate is open, but you must report to Guildmaster Krell at the Great Forge when you return. May your luck hold out in the Smelting Pits, Wanderer!

bounty_offer.specifics: Zeck, an odd old bellows-man, pays to be rid of the Bats nesting inside his great bellows below the forge.

offer.speaker: Zeck
offer.text:
Bats have nested inside my great bellows below the forge! There's no time to send for help. Down by the gate a woman named Mirva sells potions you'll surely be needing.

Now, I don't much care for heroes and their grand quests, but let me make it worth your while, friend. You look like the sort who'll do a job for coin, so I figured I'd put some your way. Heh, heh, heh...

reminder.speaker: Zeck
reminder.text: I've got nothing else to tell you just now. Good luck with those bats. They can be noisy and filthy bunch.

completion.speaker: Zeck
completion.text: Ha-HA! Now, take this purse and off you go.

journal.text:
Hunt down the Bats in order to free Zeck's great bellows.
Their nest is likely somewhere under the forge.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Dagny the smith cannot work the hot iron since Imps ran off with her Fireproof Gloves to the lava caves.

offer.speaker: Dagny
offer.text: Imps ran off with my Fireproof Gloves, down into the lava caves west of town! Will you get them back for me please?

reminder.speaker: Dagny
reminder.text: Those Imps are the pests and sworn enemies of every smith in Durgal. Going down into their caves will show if you are worthy to stand beside us at the anvil.

completion.speaker: Dagny
completion.text: Bless you, brave Adventurer! Then I must get back to my anvil -- and you must take these boots with my thanks.

after.speaker: Dagny
after.text: My deepest thanks again for bringing back my gloves!

journal.text:
Find and return the Fireproof Gloves in order to help Dagny.
The Imps have most likely hidden them in the lava caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find and return the Fireproof Gloves in order to help Dagny.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: a smith who finds the Great Forge cold, a hothead about Bargul, a woman who teases the player.

rumour1.speaker: Smith
rumour1.text: WHAT? The Great Forge is... COLD?

rumour2.speaker: Townsman
rumour2.text: We must get the ore moving again! Drive off Bargul and take back the Smelting Pits.

rumour3.speaker: Townswoman
rumour3.text: You're awful puny for a hammer-man. Hah, hah, hah...!

shop_greeting.specifics: Rudgar of the Hot Coal inn, Krenshaw the armourer, Mirva who sells potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Rudgar
inn.text: You can't be back here, stranger. Rooms are round the front of the Hot Coal.

arms.speaker: Krenshaw
arms.text: You'd better be quick I've got a sword in the fire.

magic.speaker: Mirva
magic.text: Pssst! Back here! You in want of a spell book? A potion or two, perhaps?

two_givers.specifics: Ulda the Treasurer wants the Guild Hammer the Ogres carried off to the slag caves. Fennick, jailed in town, wants the key to his cell and offers help in return.

offer_a.speaker: Ulda
offer_a.text:
Our smiths and our miners alike have paid dearly to put an end to Bargul's raids. Hmm, I suppose Guildmaster Krell has already sent you up to the Smelting Pits after him. All of Durgal is counting on you, lad.

But the Ogres also carried off our Guild Hammer, and if I don't get it back, the guild is finished. So keep your wits about you as you climb to the slag caves east of town, because the brutes won't take kindly to strangers. Look at you, not a speck of fear!

offer_b.speaker: Fennick
offer_b.text: Greetings, young sir. Bargul's Ogres have already carried off half the iron in Durgal. Fetch the cell key from the guard room. Quickly! The jailer's gone to his supper. I'd wager the brutes who took Ulda's hammer have it in the slag caves. Please, if you bring me that key and let me out of this cell, I may just be able to help you in return.

outcome_a.speaker: Ulda
outcome_a.text: Thank goodness, the hammer is home! Once it rests on the anvil again, you may wear this Chain Tunic into battle, or sell it to Krenshaw for a good price.

outcome_b.speaker: Fennick
outcome_b.text: You must keep well clear of the jailer for a while. You will meet scores of Ogres up in those caves, so take this Longsword of mine. I'm sure Ulda will reward you well for the hammer.

journal_a.text: Recover the Guild Hammer from the slag caves for Ulda the Treasurer.

journal_b.text: Free Fennick from his cell in the town jail.

rescue.specifics: Brisba's husband Grimble, a tinker, went to sell kettles to the Ogres and they locked him up in the Smelting Pits.

plea.speaker: Brisba
plea.text: Please! I shall never see my Grimble again -- he went off to sell kettles to the Ogres and they've locked him up in the Smelting Pits! If you're going up that way, bring him home to me!

reminder.speaker: Brisba
reminder.text: Bless you, dear. Go quickly. I know he can't last long up there.

found.speaker: Grimble
found.text: Am I glad to see you, young sir! Take me as far as the north gate -- just down the hill. I can make it home on my own from there.

completion.speaker: Brisba
completion.text: Hmmm. Well, you'd best take this Ankh, kind sir, if you're to stand any chance against that Bargul and his brutes!

journal.text: Rescue Grimble the Tinker from the Smelting Pits.

main_opening.specifics: A townsman sends the player to Guildmaster Krell at the Great Forge, an old friend of Orvald, who sends him against Bargul in the Smelting Pits.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: How can a town of smiths fight off Ogres? This is a disaster! Will you go see Guildmaster Krell at the Great Forge?

opening.speaker: Krell
opening.text: Friend of Orvald, a thousand thanks for answering my call... I hear the Ogre chief Bargul has seized the Smelting Pits north of town and put our ore-men to the sword, so you must be the one to drive him out!

reminder.speaker: Krell
reminder.text: That is all I can tell you. Until the Pits are ours again...

journal.text: Defeat Bargul in the Smelting Pits.
